decks.notes: The primary objective of this deck is to utilize the Allosaurus Rider combo to quickly bring out powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and Xenagos, God of Revels. This combo involves casting Allosaurus Rider for free using the green mana from Nourishing Shoal, then sacrificing it to Neoform or Eldritch Evolution to fetch a huge creature from the deck. Consign to Memory can be used to protect the combo, while Planar Genesis can help ramp up mana quickly. The deck also includes various creatures and spells to support and complement the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Goblin Bombardment, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Support cards like Voice of Victory and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah help to buff and protect your creatures, while Arena of Glory provides additional utility. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and lands to ensure a steady flow of threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and relentless assault.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It also includes cards that provide value through card draw and token generation. The deck aims to control the board with cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up a board presence to overwhelm them. It utilizes a diverse range of creatures and spells to create a flexible and dynamic strategy that can adapt to different matchups.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while building up a strong board presence with aggressive creatures. By combining removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending with disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to control the battlefield and chip away at the opponent's life total. With cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Empeor of Bones providing additional threats, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Meanwhile, cards like Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize help to disrupt the opponent's strategy and keep them off balance.

The main strategy of this deck is to use Broodscale Bloodchief's ability to generate +1/+1 counters and sacrifice creatures to take control of the game. By ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and other lands, the deck can quickly cast powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Walking Ballista to dominate the board. Combining cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command, the deck can control the opponent's creatures while building up its own army. With efficient card draw and tutor effects, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of combo pieces and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures and using combat tricks and direct damage spells to push through damage and control the battlefield. Key cards include Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for token generation, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER for removal, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for additional damage. The deck also uses cards like Goblin Bombardment and Voice of Victory for reach and finishers. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro plan while maintaining the ability to disrupt their game plan.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies while also utilizing blink effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining creatures with powerful enters-the-battlefield abilities with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can control the board and apply pressure at the same time. This allows for a versatile and dynamic gameplay experience, making it difficult for opponents to predict and counter the deck's actions. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive tactics.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using powerful colorless creatures and artifacts, while assembling the Urza lands to generate a large amount of mana. With cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies and dominate the battlefield. Cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Thought-Knot Seer provide additional control and disruption, while Mystic Forge offers card advantage. Overall, the deck combines powerful control elements with a ramp strategy to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana production and utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to generate overwhelming board presence. By assembling specific land combinations and using cards like Urza's Saga and Scapeshift, the deck can create explosive turns where multiple powerful threats come into play at once, overwhelming the opponent and leading to victory. The deck also utilizes toolbox cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cultivator Colossus to deal with specific threats and ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the board while quickly lowering your own life total to activate Death's Shadow's ability and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. This aggressive strategy is supported by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Counterspell, as well as removal like Fatal Push and Dismember. Additionally, cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent provide additional threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck aims to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a fast victory.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off. The deck also includes plenty of spells such as Lightning Bolt and Mutagenic Growth to remove threats or push through damage. The card selection tools like Preordain and Expressive Iteration help ensure a consistent and powerful draw. Dragon's Rage Channeler serves as a versatile threat that can grow in power throughout the game. Overall, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and burst damage to defeat the opponent swiftly.

This deck focuses on aggressive early plays with efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent, utilizing a diverse mana base for maximum flexibility and power. The inclusion of Leyline cards and Stubborn Denial offer protection and disruption against opposing strategies, while the top end threats like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury can close out games quickly. The deck also includes some card advantage engines like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain momentum.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Phlage, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Ajani. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of creature damage and direct burn spells, while also utilizing cards like Voice of Victory and Goblin Bombardment for added value. The inclusion of Seasoned Pyromancer and Elegant Parlor helps maintain card advantage and board presence, while cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm provide disruption and protection for your creatures. The deck's strategy revolves around swift, aggressive plays to finish off opponents efficiently.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is focused on fast and aggressive creature plays, backed up by burn spells and control elements to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. Cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide early threats, while cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment offer removal and reach. Arena of Glory and Static Prison help control the battlefield, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional support. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creature damage and burn spells to secure a quick victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to pressure the opponent. It looks to use cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage efficiently, while utilizing disruption spells like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to control the board. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional support and buffs to the team, with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offering card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful threats while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Broodscale Bloodchief creature to create a combo with various support cards such as Malevolent Rumble, Glaring Fleshraker, and Writhing Chrysalis. The deck also includes powerful cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Walking Ballista for additional threats. Kozilek's Command provides additional utility and removal. The deck's mana base is designed to support the Eldrazi theme with Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, while also including various lands for consistency. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and synergies.
